name: Kintsugi
summary: Kintsugi offers free nexus monitoring and exposure auditing, then charges $75 per action in the US and Canada for registrations, filings, amended returns and deregistrations. Real-time rate calculation on invoices appears only on its custom-priced Scale and Premium plans.

facts.text: Kintsugi tracks economic thresholds across every US state and more than 100 countries, according to its homepage.
Kintsugi says it holds a SOC 2 Type II report, available through its Trust Center.
The Starter plan includes back filings for past periods owed, a virtual mailbox for jurisdiction notices and 24/7 live chat support.
On the pricing page, real-time tax calculation on invoices is listed for Scale and Premium and not for Free or Starter.
Scale registration covers the EU, the UK and more than 100 countries, per the pricing page.

plans.notes: Nexus monitoring, liability auditing and threshold alerts
